## Orientation

Verification only. Do not edit the tree. Do not restart the server on port 8765.

### Work-item (quote)

## Description

Prove the phase exit criteria hold together: run the FastAPI dismiss, Needs-you clear, and OpenAPI checks through create_app.

R1: FastAPI POST /api/backlog with a JSON body and no query string dismisses an open backlog item.
R2: FastAPI POST /api/needs with a JSON body and no query string clears an open Needs-you item.
R3: GET /openapi.json on the FastAPI app returns 200.

## Approach

Run the three frozen pytest node ids. Do not edit the tree. Do not restart the server on port 8765.

### Requirements (quote by id)

R1: FastAPI POST /api/backlog with a JSON body and no query string dismisses an open backlog item.
R2: FastAPI POST /api/needs with a JSON body and no query string clears an open Needs-you item.
R3: GET /openapi.json on the FastAPI app returns 200.

### Design / decisions (quote)

## Invariants

`fastapi` is imported only inside `create_app`. Write handlers still delegate to `Reader.write_needs` and `Reader.write_backlog`.

## Assumptions

Postponed annotations are the only reason FastAPI treats `request` as a query parameter. A process that imported `dashboard.web.app` before this change must be restarted to pick it up.

web-write-annotation: drop postponed annotations in dashboard/web/app.py
web-write-body-grouping: ungrouped

### Frozen oracle (do not edit)

Files listed in acceptance oracle_hashes for this task are frozen.
Do not edit them. An oracle hash or test-id change is a signed amendment in `.affidavit/manifest.json`. aff verdict accepts or rejects it. A non-zero exit means the acceptance is not done.
